intro: Having you celebrate with us in El Salvador means more to us than we can put into words. We know many of you are traveling to be there, and having you by our side is truly the greatest gift. For those who have asked, we've included a registry with a few things to help us make our house a home as we begin this next chapter together. Above all, we're just so grateful to have you be part of it!
note: If you prefer, monetary gifts in the form of cash or a gift card are also welcome. You can bring them to the wedding or send them digitally. We are so grateful for your thoughtfulness and generosity as we begin this next chapter together!
